    docs/timings/census-yellow-log.tsv   an APPEND collision

The second is the interesting one. campaign/the-planetarium appended their
profiled row to the yellow log minutes ago; you appended yours. Two appends to
one file, and git cannot tell that both belong.

RESOLVE IT BY KEEPING BOTH ROWS. Neither supersedes the other — theirs is
2026-09-11T01:54:47Z at 1366.487 s, yours is 2026-09-10T16:47:07Z at 1443.918 s.
Order within the file does not matter: `census_duration.rs` has a test named
`the_chronologically_latest_row_wins_even_when_it_is_not_last_in_the_file`,
which exists precisely so rows can arrive out of order.

AND THE REASON THIS BIT YOU IS A GAP, NOT YOUR DOING. `.gitattributes` marks
five files `merge=union` — including `docs/timings.md`, the yellow log's own
sibling and an append-only ledger of exactly the same shape. The yellow log is
NOT among them. So `docs/timings.md` merges two campaigns' rows silently and
`census-yellow-log.tsv` refuses, for no reason either file's content justifies.
That the out-of-order test already exists is good evidence union is the
intended treatment and was simply never applied here.

I am recording that gap for a follow-up rather than asking you to carry it.
Resolve by keeping both rows, regenerate plumb-roster rather than editing it,
push, and I will take you — the queue has one merge ahead of you and then it is
yours.
